question.text: A 4-asset portfolio: Large-cap 40% (return 10%), Mid-cap 20% (20%), Debt 30% (7%), Gold 10% (9%). Portfolio expected return:

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio return is the weighted average of component returns: 0.40*10 + 0.20*20 + 0.30*7 + 0.10*9 = 4.0 + 4.0 + 2.1 + 0.9 = 11.0%. The Trap: The simple (un-weighted) average of 10, 20, 7 and 9 is 11.5%, which is shown as a distractor — applying weights is essential. Note: Always multiply each asset's return by its portfolio weight before summing; the simple arithmetic mean ignores allocation and can mislead.
